title: Small Fourier family for bounded-width DNF
statement:
Let $n$ be a nonnegative integer and let $f$ be a sign-valued Boolean function on the $n$-dimensional sign cube. Suppose $f$ has a DNF representation of width at most an integer $w\ge2$, and let $0<\varepsilon\le1/2$. Then there is a finite family $\mathcal F$ of subsets of the coordinates such that the sum of squared Fourier coefficients of the real-valued version of $f$ outside $\mathcal F$ is at most $\varepsilon$, and
\[|\mathcal F|\le \frac{4\left(2(20w)^{30w\lceil\log_2(12/\varepsilon)\rceil}\right)^2}{\varepsilon}.\]
hypotheses_covered: $f$ is a sign-valued Boolean function on the $n$-dimensional sign cube
$w$ is a natural number with $2\le w$
$f$ has a DNF representation of width at most $w$
